comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Travelling Merchant NPC (outside the Cathedral in St. Petersburg) has three Handicrafts recipes available, including this one. The recipe for these boots can also show up in the Handicrafts section of Quarters Aide production. For both cases, you must have the Adept of Ages (18th Century-P.3) title equipped. Ingredients:

x20 Leather Cords
x10 Suede

It is also part of a memorial album; cannot confirm if the album is in-game as of Chapter 2: Astronomy's release at this time.
